messages.subject: shinydashboard Expanded menuItem
parts:
Suppose that I have a shinydashboard sidebar with two main menu items. Each main menuItem has two sub menu items. If you press on either of the two menu items it will expand and show the two sub menu items. 

How can I tell which main menu item is expanded from my code?


Example code:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(
    title = "Shiny"
  ),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(id="sbmenu",
                menuItem("Main 1",tabName = "main1",
                         menuItem("Sub 1", tabName = "m1sub1"),
                         menuItem("Sub 2", tabName = "m1sub2" )),
                menuItem("Main 2",tabName = "main2",
                         menuItem("Sub 1", tabName = "m2sub1"),
                         menuItem("Sub 2", tabName = "m2sub2"))
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  observe(print(input$sbmenu))
}

shinyApp(ui,server)


Thank you.
